in_marathi.name: Nandakumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joy (Nanda) and God (Kumar)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nandakumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nandakumar is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a combination of two words: Nanda, which means 'joy', and Kumar, which means 'younger form of a god'. The name Nandakumar is often given to boys in Hindu culture, symbolizing the presence of joy and the divine in their lives.
